descriptionEn: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.
summaryPt: Vira Wyvern e dá um corte largo. Consome 1 Power Charge pra ganhar um buff de dano extra de raio; com o buff, o Rend cobre área maior.
wherePt: Liberada ao equipar um talismã (forma de Wyvern) — a partir do nível 6 no guia.
